# Stage 1 profile fixtures

These fixtures freeze exact profile dispatch before v1 syntax is implemented.
`positive` preserves the inherited v0.1 interpretation; `negative` selects the
recognized but unavailable v1 profile; `boundary` proves exact v1 recognition;
and `lookalike` proves similar spellings remain unknown rather than being
normalized.
